digest.component_or_area: tests/integration/rebar_reconciler/test_reconcile_roundtrip.py — module loader and ADF codec fixture
propositions: The integration test fixture _load_module unconditionally replaces sys.modules[canonical_name] without checking if the same source is already loaded, causing two distinct module objects to exist for the same canonical key.

AdfCodec retains a reference to the first module object A from unit-test collection, but the integration fixture installs a different module object B under the same canonical key, causing codec calls to stale module A while tests monkeypatch module B.

The serial test ordering causes test_cloud_functions_degrade_without_marklas to fail after test_reconcile_roundtrip runs, because B._marklas is patched but AdfCodec.to_wire still invokes A._marklas, producing inconsistent rich vs plain ADF rendering.
The _load_module helper should cache and return the already-registered module when both the canonical name and __file__ source path match, rather than unconditionally replacing sys.modules entries.

The fix establishes a runtime identity oracle (test_by_path_loader_preserves_module_identity_for_the_same_source) that enforces one module object per canonical-name/source pair while preserving intentional isolation for different sources under the same name.
